$comment: Oracle for the CARRY rule on an unrecognised member of a closed vocabulary (SPEC-32/SPEC-34, panel ruling Q1). Both reference readers run THIS file rather than being compared to each other: conformance/test_unknown_vocabulary_roundtrip.py runs the Python cells and reference/cpp/tests/test_chiplet_format_io.cpp runs the C++ cells, over the same documents and the same cells, so agreeing cell by cell is a property of the rows and not of one suite trusting the other. The cross product is deliberate and dropping any axis reproduces a defect that existed: the VALIDATE axis, because the C++ refusal lived in parse_interface, which takes no options, so validate=false did not reach it and the two readers disagreed on the same document (SPEC-34) - an implementer who 'fixes' this by gating the C++ throw behind LoadOptions::validate still fails the validate=false cell; the PATH axis, because the value has to survive the WRITER too, and a reader that carries a string a writer then drops has moved the loss rather than removed it; and the DOCUMENT axis, because the interesting document is not the one with a bare interface, it is the one whose interface meets an interposer pad with a KNOWN io_class, which is validation rule 8 and was the third refusal site. notes_per_load is the count on the NORMATIVE channel (on_warn in both readers), per load, undeduplicated: the test asserts it by loading the same document TWICE in one process and expecting two notes, which states the dedup trap as a test rather than as a comment. The schema still REFUSES both documents, and it is right to: the vocabulary is closed for WRITERS. That divergence is pinned in conformance/test_chiplet_schema.py's DIVERGENCES.

documents.why: The plain case: an interface carrying a type no reader knows, with no pad in sight.

The third refusal site: the same unknown type on an interface that meets an io_pad whose io_class (flipped_bump) HAS a row in rule 8's table, so the type matched no allowed entry and the rule reported a violation. Removing the parse-path and validate-path refusals alone leaves this document refused.
